tasks.short: Read the design and the green certification requirements, measure airflows and check installation and calibration on site, record measurements, check results against the requirements, compile the commissioning report, and send it to the assessor.

steps.what: Sheet metal worker reads the HVAC design and the green certification requirements
Sheet metal worker measures airflows and checks that HVAC systems are installed and calibrated
Sheet metal worker records measurements on paper commissioning forms
Sheet metal worker verifies results against the certification standards
Sheet metal worker compiles the commissioning report
Sheet metal worker e-mails the commissioning report to the certification assessor

tasks.design: Certification requirements for the HVAC system become a checklist per unit in the site app ({OPS_SYSTEM}), with design airflows filled in from the drawings. Measurements go into the tablet checklist with photos, and code compares each value with the design value and tolerance. The commissioning report is exported from the checklist, and once the worker has compiled and checked it, it goes to the assessor. Measuring, checking installation and judging deviations stay with the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements were read from documents, measurements written on forms and reports typed.
tasks.enabler_now: Site apps hold checklists with photos and export handover reports.
tasks.still_hard: Design values are often changed during the build without updating drawings.
tasks.human_edge: Finding the damper that someone left half closed.

reach.learn: Whether commissioning files are complete at handover.

evidence.claim: PlanRadar provides site diaries, defect logging, checklists and handover reports.
Under the Wkb the contractor and an independent quality assurer build the completion file the client submits.

assumptions: Boundary: from the design drawings to the report sent; the certification decision is outside.
Input contract: design airflows from the engineer; requirements from the certification scheme; fallback is paper forms.
Measuring and judging do not change.
The assessor reads the report as before; no added assessor time.
research_questions: Do assessors ask fewer follow-up questions?

incremental.description: Sheet metal worker sets up the checklist per project.

approvals.approved_version: The commissioning report as compiled and checked by the worker in s5.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a small system with few units; high: a large building with many units.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The sheet metal worker keeps measuring and judging installations; paper forms and typed reports shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A worker who hands over complete files on the day.
